Buy Powerball Tickets Now

The initial drawing for the Powerball game, which evolved from the preceding Lotto*America game, took place in April 1992. Over time, more states began to participate, and in 2010, Powerball and Mega Millions established an agreement allowing state lotteries to sell tickets for both games rather than just one.

In the beginning, jackpots were only paid as an annuity over a 20-year period, but in 1997, that was increased to a 25-year period and the choice to receive a smaller cash lump amount was added. Currently, the annuity has 30 payments spread over 29 years.

Powerball frequently produces enormous jackpots, and on January 13th, 2016, it set a new record of $1.58 billion. David Kaltschmidt and Maureen Smith from Florida, John and Lisa Robinson from Tennessee, and Marvin and Mae Acosta from California all shared this. They were claiming under the Nickel 95 Trust. Each winning ticket was awarded $528.8 million, or $327.8 million in cash.

On November 7, 2016, the jackpot surpassed $2 billion for the first time. A single player from California won the entire pot, which is worth $997 million as a one-time payment or $2.04 billion as an annuity.

Powerball rules

  • You can only win one prize per Powerball number line, and only the maximum eligible prize will be paid out.

  • To claim a prize, you must present a valid winning ticket. For an entry to be valid, the ticket must be complete and the data must match the computer records of the selling lottery. The ticket cannot be altered, forged, or mutilated.

  • You must claim your prizes within the time frame specified by the selling lottery where you bought your ticket. Any unclaimed prize money will be redistributed at the discretion of each selling lottery.

  • Depending on your state's rules, you may be required to choose between receiving a jackpot payout as an annuity or a lump sum within 60 days of the draw date.

  • If you die while still receiving annuity payments, the remaining balance may be paid to your estate, subject to any applicable state or federal laws. At the discretion of the selling lottery that is awarding the prize, prizes may be paid in cash, check, warrant, or electronic transfer.

  • Each selling lottery determines the prize claim period, which is 180 days if not otherwise stated. You must seek compensation from the selling lottery that sold the winning ticket.

Powerball drawing time in the UK 

The draw takes place every Tuesday, Thursday, Sunday at 4:00 a.m. in the UK.  To keep an eye on Powerball winning numbers, visit the Lottery Results & Winning Numbers on LottosOnline!

Powerball annuity

Whoever wins the Powerball lottery jackpot or another lottery prize can receive their winnings in one of two ways. They have the option of receiving the payout as an annuity, which would be paid in thirty graduated payments over twenty-nine years, or as a lump sum payment.

How Do You Win the Powerball Jackpot?

Match all five numbers plus the Powerball to win the jackpot, or match any of the non-jackpot combinations to win other fantastic cash prizes!

With the exception of the jackpot prize, all POWERBALL prizes are fixed payouts. The jackpot prize will be distributed to winners from all POWERBALL states.

Powerball jackpot rollover

The Powerball Jackpot Rollover works in a very simple way. Every time the jackpot is not won, it is added to the next drawing's jackpot amount. This process continues until the jackpot is won. As more and more people purchase Powerball tickets, the jackpot can increase quickly. If you're looking to win big, the Powerball Jackpot Rollover could be the ticket!

Powerball Lottery Jackpot Payout Options

The Powerball Lottery Jackpot Payout Options are varied and offer players several different ways to receive their winnings. Players can choose from a one-time cash lump sum payment or an annuity option that pays out over 30 years. The cash option offers the full jackpot amount in one payment, while the annuity option pays out in 30 graduated payments over a period of 29 years.
